OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
       WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE
       TIME ALLOWED:
       READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
       WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES
Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:

Patient: Melissa Gardens (Mrs)
DOB: 07/11/1954
Ht: 160 cm Wt: 65 kg BMI: 25.3(16/03/2018)
Social History: Retired Teacher
Married, 2 children (25 yrs & 10 yrs)
Nonsmoker
Nondrinker
Substance Intake: Nil
Allergies: penicillin drugs
FHx: Mother-Diabetes; hypertension; Father: Hypertension, migraine
Maternal grandmother- unknown
Maternal grandfather-died of colon cancer
Paternal grandmother-died of heart attack, 70
Paternal grandfather-unknown
PMHx:
1968 appendectomy
1993 Jaundice
 
2007 diabetes Rx metformin 500 mg od, glipizide 5 mg od
2008 menopause
2013 lumb on left breast, left lumpectomy done
2016 Gatric ulcer, hypercholerestrolemia Rx atorva 10 mg
29/03/2018
Subjective: fainted at bathroom at home, semi-conscious, trouble talking,
hospitalised by her daughter.
Objective: cold hands, extreme sweating, BSL: 3.5 mmol/L, vital signs: T-38.2
°C, P - 70 bpm, R-22/mt & B.P. -110/70, IV bolus of 50% dextrose given,
observation- 2 hrs, patient stable, stopped glipizide for one week, review at
clinic after 1 week, pathology requested: FBS, 2 hrs PPBS, FBE, U&Es,
Creatinine, LFTs, Full lipid profile, HbA1c.
30/03/2018
Pathology reports received: FBS - 5.6 mmol/L, 2 hrs PPBS – 7 mmol/L; FBE,
U&Es, Creatinine & LFTs-Normal range, Full lipid profile: chol - 6.2(high), Trig
- 2.4, LDLC - 3.6, HbA1c: 6.7%.
Review pathology reports with patient
Change in medication recommended
Atorvastatin 10mg changed to 20 mg
Glipizide 5mg restarted
Patient Requested for health education on diabetes and diet management
Refer to dietician for dietary management.

Writing task:
Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral for further
assessment and management of this patient to the dietitian, Dr. Gerald
Michael, dietitian specialist, Newton Hospital.
In your answer:

        Expand the relevant case notes into complete sentences
